17.7 Dimensions of labels on the bad copies
The auxiliary estimate in Section 7 uses a bound on the dimensions of labels occurring under
permutations of the bad copies. The good copies may remain in the representation space, but
their multiplicity does not enter this bound.

17.8 A whole-space bound for the good auxiliary labels
The logarithmic dimension comparison under restriction, together with the actual occurring-label
dimension bound on the bad copies, yields an operator inequality before measuring a physical
excitation component.

This is the operator input to [ Ope26b, Section 7, equation (comparator:good-auxiliary)]. To
